- **[King Arthur Gluten-Free Chocolate Chip Cookies](https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/recipes/gluten-free-chocolate-chip-cookies-recipe)**: Uses a gluten-free all-purpose flour blend; the listed chopped nuts are optional, so leave them out.
